ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (BattleTrance.cs:15-18) == cost 0 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF. No keywords, no tags.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new CardsVar(3)` (BattleTrance.cs:13) == `_cards = 3`, read as `DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue` at the draw site. `_cards` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` so `magic_number` surfaces 3.

OnPlay.rationale: Order and both effects match: `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` FIRST (BattleTrance.cs:22) == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, self._cards)`, then `PowerCmd.Apply<NoDrawPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (23) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, NoDrawPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. The order is load-bearing on both sides -- NoDrawPower is applied AFTER the draw, so this card's own draw is never blocked by it. The draw verb's internals (reshuffle-on-empty, MaxCardsInHand, per-card hooks) are creature_card_cmds seam territory, not card-level.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Cards.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (BattleTrance.cs:28) == `self._cards += 1` (3 -> 4). The NoDrawPower amount stays 1 when upgraded on both sides. Downgrade-safe; `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list battle_trance.

guards.what: no TargetType.AnyEnemy null-check and no animation trigger -- this card's OnPlay is unguarded on both sides
guards.rationale: Nothing to mirror. Recorded so the absence of a guard is a checked fact rather than an omission.
